description: Two independent latches: a voltage at TRIG sets the output high and one at RESET sets it low, each side taking up to 16 polyphonic channels

inputs.text: 1V or more sets that side's LATCH output to 10V and holds it there; while the latch is already set, further voltage here changes nothing
1V or more returns that side's LATCH output to 0V, and while the voltage is held that side's TRIG input cannot set the latch again

outputs.text: 10V while that side's latch is set and 0V while it is clear, carrying as many channels as the busier of that side's two inputs

notes: the inputs are read as levels rather than as edges: any voltage of 1V or more counts, whether it arrives as a trigger, a gate or a slow ramp crossing 1V.
the two sides share nothing. With 16 channels into each, the module holds 32 separate latches.
a change of state is followed by one sample in which that channel accepts neither input, which keeps a trigger and a reset arriving together from fighting over the latch.
